state.background: The user approved retiring the standalone Playwright tooltip #231 case in favor of the existing Browser Mode owner. Exact source comparison found that tests/e2e/tooltip-dismiss.e2e.spec.ts has one runnable mobile Pixel 7 case: it hit-tests a production chart bar, touchscreen-taps it, expects the tooltip close button and cursor, then sends a 60px wheel event with no post-scroll assertion. Existing tests/browser-mode/batch3-b-production-route.browser.test.ts case p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-231-case01 uses the same production-route hit-tested touch target and open assertions; it also asserts scroll movement and dismissal (tooltip and cursor gone). Its context is mobile 412x915 with isMobile/hasTouch, while Playwright uses the Pixel 7 emulation. No Pixel 7-specific requirement was identified and the user accepted the Browser Mode alternative. The residual spec's only runnable case is #231; remove that case while preserving the pre-task empty desktop describe and already-absent unknown-provenance test bodies. With no active Playwright E2E cases left, `test:full` must not invoke `test:e2e`; retain the standalone `test:e2e` script for future cases because `scripts/hook-smoke.mjs` checks that script exists. Remove the stale tooltip matcher from playwright.config.ts. Do not change the existing Browser Mode owner. Append superseding documentation while preserving historical logs and the original 33-case ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove only the active mobile #231 test and its stale mobile-pixel project matcher after documenting the same-boundary Browser Mode owner; preserve the pre-existing empty desktop describe and already-absent unknown test bodies.
Keep tests/browser-mode/batch3-b-production-route.browser.test.ts and its production-route touch/scroll checks unchanged; focused validation passes.
Remove `pnpm run test:e2e` only from `test:full` because no runnable Playwright E2E cases remain, while preserving the standalone `test:e2e` script and hook-smoke contract.
Update inventory and plan records with a superseding decision, preserve historical results and unknown-provenance notes, and keep A=123/E=123/M=123 for the original cohort.
The remaining `test:full` gates and diff check pass; accurately disclose that standalone Playwright has no active cases instead of claiming an empty E2E run passed.
verification: The prior B14 full Browser Mode validation included the B3b production-route tooltip case and passed 138 tests with 5 skipped: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-b14-full-browser-mode-validation-pass2-2026-09-27.log.
Current residual E2E run had 1 pass and 1 project skip; the only runnable logical case was #231.
knownConstraints: Browser Mode emulates mobile touch at 412x915; it does not preserve Pixel 7 device scale factor or UA as a distinct assertion boundary.
Vitest Browser Mode still uses its configured browser provider; this change removes the separate empty Playwright E2E stage from test:full rather than all browser startup from the project.
Historical validation logs and the original 33-case migration ledger remain snapshots and must not be rewritten as if this retirement had already happened.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For any non-pass reason, provide a case-specific finding, affected requirement/location, observed evidence, and concrete proposed correction or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent facts.

plan.instructions: Is retirement of the residual #231 Playwright E2E and removal of the now-empty test:full E2E stage sufficiently supported and correctly scoped, given the existing Browser Mode assertions and Pixel 7 emulation difference? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The plan preserves all live behavioral assertions under the existing Browser Mode owner, scopes the Pixel 7 profile difference transparently, and avoids calling Playwright with no E2E cases.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A required behavior is not covered by the proposed owner; identify the exact assertion and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific product requirement or decision about Pixel 7 fidelity is still needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: A concrete implementation or validation detail is missing.
criteria.implementation_issue: The proposed removal or test ownership is technically unsound; identify the location and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan changes tests or gates outside the approved residual tooltip scope; identify the boundary.
criteria.other: A material case-specific concern does not fit the listed reasons; give evidence and required fix.
criteria.indeterminate: Available evidence is insufficient; identify the exact evidence needed.
